```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
matches <- read_csv("data/matches.csv")
```


```{python}
import pandas as pd

with open('data/sätze_y.txt', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    sentences = f.read().splitlines()

df = pd.DataFrame(sentences, columns=['input'])

df.to_csv('data/saetze.csv', index=False, encoding='utf-8')
```

```{r}
df <- read_csv("data/saetze.csv")
```
```{r}
final <- bind_cols(matches,df)
```


```{r}
write.csv(final, "data/final.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```



```{r}
sentiment <- read_csv("data/sentiment.csv") |> 
    select(-input)
```


```{r}
final_w_sen <- bind_cols(final,sentiment)
```

```{r}
write.csv(final, "data/final_w_sent.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
